idalib-mcp.description: Read-only IDA Pro decompiler through idalib. Start scripts/idalib-mcp-streamable.py once per target binary with an available port; the server opens exactly that binary and exposes real upstream tool names over Streamable HTTP /mcp. Port 8745 is excluded by the local Windows policy, so the project default is 18745.

jadx.description: JADX Android/Java decompiler bridge (jadx-mcp). Decompile classes/methods, read source, search, inspect the manifest of a loaded APK/DEX.
